note: Pendleton County WV: 2021 County Commission minutes state the county has no zoning laws in effect. No county or town (Franklin, the only incorporated municipality) zoning district layer found in ArcGIS Online, county GIS (gismaps.org) or town website. The only ArcGIS layer named Pendleton_Zoning (services3.arcgis.com/tNPgIZWOB0Efvm0g) is for City of Pendleton, Oregon (airport zones AA, Pendleton OR coordinates), not this county. Franklin's ArcGIS zoning map item is Franklin, Tennessee.
